messages.author: Sadaf Rani
messages.body:
Dear Amber users
While trying to do pdb4amber I get the following error message:-
File "/opt/anaconda/bin/pdb4amber", line 6, in <module>
from pkg_resources import load_entry_point
File
"/opt/anaconda/lib/python3.7/site-packages/pkg_resources/__init__.py", line
3267, in <module>
._call_aside
File
"/opt/anaconda/lib/python3.7/site-packages/pkg_resources/__init__.py", line
3251, in _call_aside
f(*args, **kwargs)
File
"/opt/anaconda/lib/python3.7/site-packages/pkg_resources/__init__.py", line
3280, in _initialize_mas               ter_working_set
working_set = WorkingSet._build_master()
File
"/opt/anaconda/lib/python3.7/site-packages/pkg_resources/__init__.py", line
582, in _build_master
ws.require(__requires__)
File
"/opt/anaconda/lib/python3.7/site-packages/pkg_resources/__init__.py", line
899, in require
needed = self.resolve(parse_requirements(requirements))
File
"/opt/anaconda/lib/python3.7/site-packages/pkg_resources/__init__.py", line
785, in resolve
raise DistributionNotFound(req, requirers)
pkg_resources.DistributionNotFound: The 'pdb4amber==1.6.dev0' distribution
was not found and is required by                the application
I am not very well conversant with anaconda. Could you please guide me on
how should I correct it?
Regards
Sadaf

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Fri, Jul 16, 2021, Sadaf Rani wrote:
>While trying to do pdb4amber I get the following error message:-
>File "/opt/anaconda/bin/pdb4amber", line 6, in <module>
Can you say exactly how you installed AmberTools?  Are you using the conda
package for AmberTools21?
>  File
>"/opt/anaconda/lib/python3.7/site-packages/pkg_resources/__init__.py", line
>785, in resolve
>    raise DistributionNotFound(req, requirers)
>pkg_resources.DistributionNotFound: The 'pdb4amber==1.6.dev0' distribution
>was not found and is required by                the application
>
No one has reported this problem before, so details are important: we need
to find out how your setup differs from others.  I follow exactly the
instructions here:
https://ambermd.org/GetAmber.php
Let us know about your OS, conda/anaconda environment, etc.
...thanks....dave
